note: Runtime affordances are seeded and grounded by aura_affordance_directory.py. Extension entries are merged only when their IDs are not already present and remain advisory-only.
description: Aura Affordance Directory seed map. Each entry describes an internal Aura capability that agents should consider before inventing generic solutions. Grounded against CODEMAP at load time.

affordances.name: Coding Waboose Review Lessons
affordances.description: Normalizes CodeRabbit, Codex, and manual PR review evidence into typed dispositions, deterministic detectors, and Crucible replay receipts before Coding Waboose re-proves findings against exact source and tests.
affordances.when_to_use: When a coding or Agent Bridge run should reuse defect classes learned from external or manual review, replay adversarial regressions, or normalize current versus historical review evidence.
affordances.when_not_to_use: Do not use it as proof that current source is defective, as a patch generator, or as commit, pull-request, merge, promotion, or production authority.
affordances.safety: External reviewer output and learned patterns are teacher signals only. Exact-source and regression corroboration are required. No automatic fix, commit, push, pull request, merge, promotion, or production mutation.
affordances.prompt_card: Use Coding Waboose Review Lessons to replay known defect classes and guide exact-source investigation; never treat reviewer memory as self-proving authority.
